name: agentic-angular-app
description: Hands-on learning project: Agentic UI with Angular, CopilotKit, AG-UI, A2UI and MCP

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix mcp-server install && npm --prefix client install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: concurrently -n mcp,agent,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix mcp-server run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix mcp-server run typecheck
